title: Meta Advantage+ App (AAP) Optimization
deck: Meta AAP mandates OS-split operation, with a separate SKAN-channel campaign for iOS. Meta's default attribution is 7d click + 1d view; evaluate iOS 14.5+ traffic on a reduced 1d click basis so it lines up with other networks.
summary: AAP (Advantage+ App Campaigns) is Meta's automated campaign type. Ad-set-level fine control is limited and campaign-level optimization is enforced. Meta's default attribution is 7-day click + 1-day view; the standard practice is to report on a reduced 1d_click basis so numbers are comparable with the MMP and other networks. iOS uses the AEM 8-event priority list; Android sends the full in-app event set.

content.html: Split on three axes: OS × country × optimization goal. iOS additionally gets a dedicated SKAN campaign.

items: Meta Ads Manager → Create campaign → objective: App Promotion
Campaign type: select Advantage+ App Campaign (not Manual App Ads)
Select the app → confirm the App ID registered in Adjust
Choose the optimization event (Install / In-App Event / Value)
Budget: campaign-level daily budget recommended. ABO (Ad-Set Budget Optimization) is disabled in AAP
Audience: automatic (Advantage+ Audience). Only exclusions are manual — exclude purchasers from the last 30 days
Creative: upload up to 50 assets. Meta auto-generates combinations
Attribution window (Meta default): 7-day click + 1-day view. iOS 14.5+ ATT-declined traffic is automatically limited to the SKAN postback window (0–2 days).

Operating recommendation (cross-network comparison): evaluate on reduced 1-day click when reporting, so numbers align with Google/TikTok. Expect 1d_click to report roughly 30–40% lower than Meta's default 7d_click.
Bid strategy: escalate Highest Volume (auto) → Cost Cap → Bid Cap in stages. Run Highest Volume for the first 7 days to accelerate learning.
VBO (Value Optimization): revenue-based bidding. Enable after purchases stabilize at 50+/day.

content.title: iOS campaign installs suddenly drop in reporting
content.html: Likely SKAN postback delay or a recent AEM priority change. Check the AEM Priority change history in Meta Events Manager — a change resets learning and can blank out reporting for up to 28 days.

content.title: Revenue is inconsistent in a VBO campaign
content.html: Confirm revenue sending is enabled for the purchase event in Adjust → Meta Partner. AEM's value_optimization toggle must be ON. On iOS, only revenue captured within the SKAN postback window (0–2 days) feeds the signal.

content.title: Advantage+ vs regular campaigns — how to choose
content.html: Under ~$100/day budget or with a narrow audience (e.g. a specific profession), use regular App Ads. With $100+/day and a mass audience, use AAP — it fills its learning volume faster.
